title: 第26章 孔府邀请，天降瑞雪
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
“白杨镇的三班捕快，分为缉盗，安民，税政，每班十二人，分别负责追捕盗匪，城内安民，以及税款收取。”

    “只是这多年来，税政一班发展越发壮大，安民一班名存实亡，倒是咱们缉盗，呵呵……”

    褚二摇着头，面容苦涩。

    “上任捕头竟然跟周围的盗匪，沆瀣一气，只要盗匪能够及时上供，那捕头就会对他们睁一只眼闭一只眼，甚至有时候还会主动提供情报。”

    不知道为什么，陆林听到这话，第一个想到的，就是张生财。

    这位张家家主外出做生意，被人劫掠，差点血本无归。

    若不是孔府接济，恐怕早就家财破败。

    这事说不好就是上任捕头干的。

    “不过好在任大人来了。”

    说到任忠武，褚二明显精神亢奋。

    “任大人为人刚直不阿，在县城也是得罪了小人，造人排挤，没有晋身机会，只能申请外放。”

    “他一来，就带着我和牛三外出走访查探，把周围十多处匪徒的窝点打听清楚。”

    “若不是只凭我们三人无法拿下所有匪徒，这些家伙休想活到过年。”

    “不过也快了，任大人此去述职，定能说动县尊大人，调动兵马来剿灭匪患，还百姓们一个朗朗乾坤。”

    “哎，说多了说多了，陆兄弟，我给你讲讲咱们这些皂衣捕快的福利待遇，以及日常的工作吧。”

    皂衣捕快。

    是捕快体系中，最低等级的存在。

    即便如此，仍旧是普通人可望不可即的职位。

    正式武者。

    这是硬性条件。

    没有达到者，一律不予录用。

    任忠武也是看陆林接近，这才提前征召。

    此外，还要是身家清白，祖上三代，都不允许跟匪徒有任何交集。

    月俸为八两银子，每次出任务，或者有功绩，另有赏赐。

    日常工作倒是简单。

    寻找线索，锁定踪迹，查询物证，缉捕盗匪。

    但说来简单，做起来却一点都不容易。

    小小的白杨镇，死水一潭，容不得半点浪花。

    任忠武上任不过半个多月，就足有几十场宴请排队等着。

    送玉器，送金银，送字画，送女子，送房产。

    只要你稍微露出半点意向，数不尽的诱惑便会接踵而来。

    好一些的，沦为这些世家大户的保镖，官场传声筒。

    差一些的，那就不得而知了。

    褚二也只是听说，几十年前，白杨镇以及周边的镇子，光是捕头，一年就能换七八个。

    要么惨死在荒野，要么就是失踪多年，杳无音信。

    “不过你也不用太过担心，现在有任大人在前面顶着，咱们只要安心做事即可。”

    “你之前乃是山中猎户，擅长弓箭，寻踪追击应该也不在话下，等年后任大人回来，咱们就能忙起来了。”

    一番交谈，让陆林对白杨镇的情况了解不少。
content_en:
"The three squads of police officers in Baiyang Town are divided into anti-robbery, civilian security, and tax administration. There are twelve people in each squad. They are responsible for hunting down bandits, calming the people in the city, and collecting taxes."

    "It's just that over the past few years, the Tax Affairs Division has grown stronger and stronger, and the Anmin Division exists in name only, but we are hunting for theft, haha..."

    Chu Er shook his head, with a bitter look on his face.

    "The previous chief was colluding with the bandits around him. As long as the bandits could turn in their confessions in time, the chief would turn a blind eye to them, and sometimes even proactively provide information."

    For some reason, when Lu Lin heard this, the first thing he thought of was Zhang Shengcai.

    The head of the Zhang family went out on business and was robbed, almost losing all his money.

    If it weren't for the help from the Confucius Mansion, I'm afraid the family fortune would have been ruined long ago.

    It's hard to say that this was probably done by the previous arrester.

    "But fortunately, Master Ren is here."

    Speaking of Ren Zhongwu, Chu Er was obviously in high spirits.

    "Master Ren is upright and upright. He also offended villains in the county. He was squeezed out by others and had no chance of promotion. He had to apply for release."

    "As soon as he came, he took Niu San and I out to investigate and find out more than a dozen gangster dens around us."

    "If it weren't for the three of us who couldn't take down all the gangsters, these guys would never have survived until the New Year."

    "But it's coming soon. Sir Ren is here to report on his duties. He will definitely be able to persuade the county magistrate to mobilize troops and horses to eliminate the banditry and restore peace to the people."

    "Hey, I've talked too much, brother Lu, let me tell you about the benefits and daily work of us Zaoyi agents."

    Zaoyi catcher.

    It is the lowest level existence in the police system.

    Even so, it is still a position that is out of reach for ordinary people.

    Official warrior.

    This is a hard condition.

    Those who do not meet the requirements will not be hired.

    Ren Zhongwu also saw Lu Lin approaching, so he recruited him in advance.

    In addition, the family must be clean. Three generations of ancestors are not allowed to have any interaction with gangsters.

    The monthly salary is eight taels of silver, and every time you go on a mission or have meritorious deeds, you will be rewarded.

    Daily work is simple.

    Look for clues, locate traces, examine physical evidence, and arrest robbers.

    But it is simple to say, but not easy to do at all.

    The small town of Baiyang has a pool of stagnant water that cannot tolerate any waves.

    Ren Zhongwu has only been in office for more than half a month, and he already has dozens of banquets lined up.

    Give jade, gold and silver, calligraphy and painting, women, and real estate.

    As long as you show the slightest intention, countless temptations will follow.

    The better ones have become the bodyguards and official mouthpieces of these wealthy families.

    If it's worse, it's unknown.

    Chu Er only heard that a few decades ago, in Baiyang Town and surrounding towns, seven or eight heads could be captured a year.

    Either he died tragically in the wilderness, or he disappeared for many years without any news.

    "But you don't have to worry too much. Now that Mr. Ren is in front of you, we just need to work with peace of mind."

    "You used to be a hunter in the mountains. You are good at bows and arrows. Tracking and tracking should be no problem. When Master Ren comes back in the next year, we can get busy."

    After a conversation, Lu Lin learned a lot about the situation in Baiyang Town.
title_en: Chapter 26 Invitation from the Confucius Mansion, auspicious snow falls from the sky
